label: Python performance budgets (pytest-benchmark)
description: The project's pytest-benchmark benchmarks, compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: pytest-benchmark in requirements*.txt or pyproject.toml; runs only where performance is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
